blocks.tamil_translation: equal to surahs of such excellence,” the Prophet ﷺ said to me. “I heard the Prophet ﷺ recite these surahs in Salah when he led us as imam,” says Hazrat Uqbah ibn Amir (RA).

blocks.text:
Explanation:- “Juhfah' and “Abwa' are the names of two well-known places that were on the route between Makkah Mukarramah and Madinah Munawwarah.
(Badhl al-Majhud)
4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah

blocks.tamil_translation: So remember Me; I will remember you.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلاً۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Remember the name of your Rabb! (Making worship and supplication for Him alone) devote yourself completely to Him!.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Know that it is only through the remembrance of Allah that hearts find peace.
And the Dhikr of Allah is indeed the greatest.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (اَلَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللهَ قِيَاماً وَّقُعُودًا وَعَلي جُنُوبِهِمْ۞).
